description: Check a tool before your agent connects to it: how much money could be lost if the tool, or the agent using it, is wrong, hacked or prompt-injected? Returns the Safety score (human approval, guardrails outside the agent, test mode, sending funds out, who holds the keys, open source or audited, incident record), each input with its reason and source; missing inputs are listed, not guessed. Omit tool to rank every tool in a category (e.g. agent_wallet, bot_exchange, broker_mcp).

category.description: Rank a category instead, e.g. agent_wallet, agent_payments, ai_trading_agent, bot_exchange, defi_agent or broker_mcp

name: get_risk
title: Safety score for a tool
